items.text: remembers everyone's birthday but forgets their own
still has every text from their first crush saved
sleeps with a teddy bear they refuse to name
has worn the same three outfits on rotation since 2019
cries at insurance adverts
talks to their houseplants by name
has a list of ten life goals and has ticked off one
keeps a diary where every single entry just says fine
writes a birthday card to every friend who moved abroad
hoards phone chargers in a drawer labelled just in case
owns a wardrobe that is ninety percent black
believes they can fix anything with duct tape
collects plastic bags from every supermarket they enter
knows the bus timetable by heart and still runs for it
wanted to be a vet but faints at a paper cut
has seen the same film forty times and quotes it wrong every time
replies to memes with a three paragraph essay
never finishes a board game and blames the rules
keeps every concert ticket stub since they were fifteen
sets nine alarms and snoozes all of them
keeps a savings spreadsheet and spends the money on plants
hugs everyone at the end of every phone call
cannot sit still through a whole film at the cinema
collects a tiny soap from every hotel they stay in
has an irrational fear of ducks and won't explain it
starts a new hobby every month and finishes none
writes to-do lists just to tick off things already done
makes friends with the waiter and orders for the whole table
takes three days to answer are you ok, then says yeah
says they are not a morning person and runs at six am
puts ketchup on everything, including dessert
writes a thank-you note for every gift they have ever received
knows the name of every bus driver on their route
makes a wish on every birthday candle, even at forty
still has the first pair of trainers they ever bought
